definition.title: Elastic Tabs
definition.desc: A measured indicator stretches between Inbox, Drafts, Sent and Archive, then settles. Arrow keys, Home and End move selection; rapid input retargets the indicator from its current position.
definition.seen: Pattern family: inbox tabs, segmented navigation and compact settings controls
definition.hint: Press · The indicator stretches between tabs, then settles
definition.prompt: Build a single original 260 by 40px mailbox tab rail matching the v4 INTRX tile. Its four native accessible tabs are Inbox, Drafts, Sent and Archive. Use 13px medium Inter, a #171717 rail, 12px corners and a 1px 6% white border. The selected indicator is #272727 with 9px corners, a thin inset top highlight and restrained layered shadows. It moves through the actual unscaled offsetLeft geometry. Keep the original interruptible spring equations v=(v+(target-x)*.14)*.72 and x+=v; settle below .08 position error and .04 velocity. Accumulate virtual requestAnimationFrame time in 60Hz steps so runtime speed changes preserve the same spring trajectory. Map absolute velocity to at most .42 horizontal stretch and paired vertical squash, preserving velocity when retargeted. Render no surrounding panel, heading, body copy, telemetry labels or in-demo reset controls. Expose next and replay actions through ctx. Full mode starts at Inbox; a thumbnail starts on Drafts and cycles gently until directly interacted with. Reduced motion freezes the Drafts thumbnail and directly selects requested tabs without autoplay. Support ArrowLeft/Right, Home/End, roving tab focus, live selection announcements, a light stage variant, runtime suspension, observer cleanup and complete portable export. Center the rail on a transparent 260 by 100 design plane.
